info.title: Labyrinth Backend API - Complete Documentation
info.description: Complete API documentation for Labyrinth collaborative developer platform with 83 endpoints across 8 modules: Authentication (8), User Profile (17), Matchmaking (6), Chat (11), Projects (13), Friends (9), Media (13), Presence (6)

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User authentication and account management (8 endpoints)

tags.name: User Profile
tags.description: User profile, demographics, tech stack, and workspace management (17 endpoints)

tags.name: Matchmaking
tags.description: AI-powered user and project recommendations, swipes, matches (6 endpoints)

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: Real-time messaging, chat management, Pusher integration (11 endpoints)

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Project CRUD, collaborators, tasks, analytics (13 endpoints)

tags.name: Friends
tags.description: Friend requests, friendship management, user search (9 endpoints)

tags.name: Media
